findings: Canonical events.log contains one direct close_overhead_sec observation: 32s on the 12m mixed-load pass.
14m and 16m clean closes provide overshoot but not isolated pre_close-to-close_end timing, so they cannot be added as close-overhead samples.
The state close_reserve_sec=60 is conservative configuration, not yet an empirically promoted reserve under the sparse-sample estimator.
This 18m probe should capture a second direct close-overhead sample if it reaches clean close.
